changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Create backup table for preferred flags from existing CIEL concept names before OCL/CIEL import. This table is used only to allow rollback/recovery if the import fails after clearing preferred flags.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS healthmesh_ciel_preferred_backup ( backup_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, concept_name_id INT NOT NULL, concept_id INT NOT NULL, concept_uuid CHAR(38) NOT NULL, concept_name_uuid CHAR(38), name VARCHAR(255), locale VARCHAR(50), locale_preferred BOOLEAN, concept_name_type VARCHAR(50), voided BOOLEAN, backed_up_at DATETIME NOT NULL, backup_reason VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY hm_ciel_pref_backup_once (concept_name_id, backup_reason) );

changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Backup all currently preferred names for existing CIEL-style concepts before clearing locale_preferred. CIEL-style concepts are identified by UUID pattern: numeric id followed by many A characters.
changeSet.sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO healthmesh_ciel_preferred_backup ( concept_name_id, concept_id, concept_uuid, concept_name_uuid, name, locale, locale_preferred, concept_name_type, voided, backed_up_at, backup_reason ) SELECT cn.concept_name_id, cn.concept_id, c.uuid AS concept_uuid, cn.uuid AS concept_name_uuid, cn.name, cn.locale, cn.locale_preferred, cn.concept_name_type, cn.voided, NOW(), 'Before clearing all existing CIEL preferred flags for OCL import 20260609-02' FROM concept_name cn JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = cn.concept_id WHERE c.uuid REGEXP '^[0-9]+A{20,}$' AND cn.locale_preferred = TRUE;

changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Clear all preferred flags from existing CIEL concept names before importing CIEL through OCL. This avoids ConceptValidator failures caused by the importer merging an existing preferred name with an incoming preferred name for the same locale.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE concept_name cn JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = cn.concept_id SET cn.locale_preferred = FALSE WHERE c.uuid REGEXP '^[0-9]+A{20,}$' AND cn.locale_preferred = TRUE;
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE concept_name cn JOIN healthmesh_ciel_preferred_backup b ON b.concept_name_id = cn.concept_name_id SET cn.locale_preferred = b.locale_preferred WHERE b.backup_reason = 'Before clearing all existing CIEL preferred flags for OCL import 20260609-02';

changeSet.author: HealthMesh

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concept_name cn JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = cn.concept_id WHERE c.uuid REGEXP '^[0-9]+A{20,}$' AND cn.locale_preferred = TRUE

changeSet.comment: Stop startup if any existing CIEL concept name remains preferred before OCL/CIEL import.
changeSet.sql: SELECT 'OK: no existing CIEL preferred concept names remain before OCL import' AS healthmesh_ciel_preimport_check;
